# Data Model: Genericize SpecKit Configuration

## Overview

This feature involves no runtime entities or database models. The "data model" is the **file taxonomy** — the classification of every configuration file into one of three tiers:

## File Tiers

### Tier 1: Core SpecKit (fully generic, technology-agnostic)

Files that define the SpecKit workflow and must work in any project without modification.

| File/Directory | Purpose |
|----------------|---------|
| `CLAUDE.md` | Core workflow documentation, generic agents, wave execution |
| `.claude/commands/speckit.*.md` | SpecKit workflow commands |
| `.claude/agents/solution-architect.md` | Architecture agent (generic) |
| `.claude/agents/backend-developer.md` | Backend agent (generic) |
| `.claude/agents/frontend-developer.md` | Frontend agent (generic) |
| `.claude/agents/test-engineer.md` | Testing agent (generic) |
| `.claude/agents/database-architect.md` | Database agent (generic) |
| `.claude/agents/security-auditor.md` | Security agent (generic) |
| `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` | Review agent (generic) |
| `.claude/skills/implementation-execution.md` | Wave execution skill (generic) |
| `.claude/skills/external-plugins.md` | Plugin management (generic) |
| `.claude/settings.json` | Core Claude Code settings |
| `.claude/hooks.json` | Core hooks with customizable tech patterns |
| `.specify/templates/` | All templates (already generic) |
| `.specify/scripts/` | All scripts (already generic) |
| `.specify/memory/constitution.md` | Generic software engineering constitution |

### Tier 2: Technology Profile (project-customizable)

Files containing technology-specific content (.NET, Python, Node.js, etc.) that a project customizes for its stack.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `CLAUDE.project.md` | Technology conventions, domain agents, MCP servers, build/test commands |

### Tier 3: Domain Extensions (optional add-ons)

Files providing specialized domain knowledge. Can be added or removed per project without affecting Tier 1 or Tier 2.

| File/Directory | Purpose |
|----------------|---------|
| `.claude/agents/breezsdk-*.md` (5 files) | BreezSDK domain agents |
| `.claude/agents/umbraco-*.md` (5 files) | Umbraco domain agents |
| `.claude/skills/breezsdk-knowledge.md` | BreezSDK technical knowledge |

## Relationships

```
Tier 1 (Core) ──── standalone, no references to Tier 2 or 3
    │
    └─── Tier 2 (Technology Profile) ──── references Tier 1 patterns, adds tech specifics
              │
              └─── Tier 3 (Domain Extensions) ──── references Tier 1 and 2, adds domain expertise
```

**Dependency rule**: Higher-tier files may reference lower-tier files, never the reverse. Core files must never reference technology or domain files.

## Validation Rules

1. **No Tier 1 file may contain**: BreezSDK, Umbraco, Lightning, breez, umbraco (case-insensitive)
2. **No Tier 1 file may contain** technology-specific tool references as hardcoded requirements (e.g., `dotnet build` as the only option)
3. **Tier 2 file must be self-contained**: Removing `CLAUDE.project.md` must not break any Tier 1 file
4. **Tier 3 files must be self-contained**: Removing all `breezsdk-*` or `umbraco-*` agent files must not break any Tier 1 or Tier 2 file
